graders.evidence:
Verdict: request changes - function (file-level scope, `form.jsx`), concern accessibility, depth default - 2 block FAIL, 0 should-fix FAIL, 0 PASS, the rest N/A

FAIL [block] fn-form-control-has-label - form.jsx:5-10 - proven: the email `<input>` has no `<label>`; its only name is `placeholder="Email address"` (line 7), which disappears once typed into and is not a label. Add a visible label tied by `htmlFor`/`id`, e.g. `<label htmlFor="email">Email address</label>` and `<input id="email" type="email" …/>`. This also covers fn-label-above-field, which is N/A on its own because no visible label exists to position.

FAIL [block] fn-native-button-or-link - form.jsx:11-13 - proven: "Sign up" is a `<div className="btn" onClick={onSubmit}>`. It cannot receive keyboard focus, has no button role, and does not submit the form on Enter or Space, so keyboard and screen-reader users cannot find or operate the action. Enter in the email field does submit the form, but that is implicit submission, and the control itself is still not usable. Fix: `<button type="submit" className="btn">Sign up</button>` and drop the `onClick`, since the form's `onSubmit` already handles it.

graders.name: scope
graders.evidence:
Verdict: request changes - function (ui cards), accessibility concern, depth default - 2 block FAIL, 0 should-fix FAIL, 0 PASS, 18 N/A, 1 discuss not shown

FAIL [block] fn-form-control-has-label - form.jsx:5-10 - proven: the `<input>` has a placeholder "Email address" and no `<label>`, no `id`, and no `aria-label`. A placeholder disappears once typed into and is not a reliable accessible name.

FAIL [block] fn-native-button-or-link - form.jsx:11-13 - proven: the submit control is `<div className="btn" onClick={onSubmit}>`. It is not focusable, has no button role, and cannot be activated with Enter or Space. This also means it has no focus indicator (fn-focus-indicator-visible), so that card's check is N/A here and the finding stands under this card. A keyboard user can still submit by pressing Enter in the email field, because a form with one text field submits implicitly, but the visible control itself is not operable.

N/A (applies_when does not hold in this file): fn-aria-role-has-state-and-keys, fn-colour-not-sole-cue, fn-dialog-focus-managed, fn-error-says-what-and-how, fn-heading-structure, fn-img-alt-text, fn-keep-input-on-error, fn-no-positive-tabindex, fn-reduced-motion-respected, fn-related-controls-in-fieldset, fn-status-announced-live-region

N/A - not read: fn-target-size (the `.btn` styles are not in the input, so the 24 px size cannot be checked)

N/A (level not in input, only form.jsx was given): mod-colour-tokens-meet-contrast, svc-no-redundant-entry, svc-reflow-and-zoom, svc-slow-operation-shows-progress, sys-consistent-ui-terms, code-a11y-check-in-ci, prod-a11y-audit-before-launch, chg-ui-change-screenshots-and-keyboard-pass

Hidden by depth: 1 discuss not shown (fn-label-above-field, the same missing label as the block finding above, so it adds no new defect).

Note outside the ledger, not a card finding: the email input has no `autocomplete="email"`, which helps users who rely on autofill. No card in the accessibility set covers it.

Fix direction: add a visible `<label htmlFor>` with a matching `id` on the input, and replace the div with `<button type="submit">` inside the form. Once the button is a real submit control, `onClick={onSubmit}` is no longer needed because the form's `onSubmit` handles it. I have not edited the file.

graders.evidence:

A placeholder is not a label, so screen readers announce the field without a name and voice-control users cannot target it by name. Fix: add `<label htmlFor="email">Email address</label>` and `id="email"` on the input, and keep the placeholder only as a hint. gate: ESLint `jsx-a11y/label-has-associated-control`, axe `label`.

FAIL [block] fn-native-button-or-link - form.jsx:11-13 - proven: "Sign up" is a `<div className="btn" onClick={onSubmit}>`. A div is not in the tab order, has no role, and ignores Enter and Space, so keyboard and screen-reader users cannot submit with it. Fix: `<button type="submit" className="btn">Sign up</button>` and remove the `onClick`, since the form's `onSubmit` already handles it. gate: ESLint `jsx-a11y/click-events-have-key-events` and `jsx-a11y/no-static-element-interactions`.

N/A (applies_when does not hold): fn-aria-role-has-state-and-keys, fn-colour-not-sole-cue, fn-dialog-focus-managed, fn-error-says-what-and-how, fn-focus-indicator-visible, fn-heading-structure, fn-img-alt-text, fn-label-above-field, fn-no-positive-tabindex, fn-reduced-motion-respected, fn-related-controls-in-fieldset, fn-status-announced-live-region, fn-target-size

- The module, service, and codebase accessibility cards (for example, the colour-contrast token check and the axe-in-CI check) are outside a single-file review and were not checked.
